items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: a fella by the name of Warren took me down there. And, you know, he made the first suit for me.

ctx.x: Now if you get down to the real brass tacks, where did you guys go for a good time when you were in high school? Where did you take a girl when you were in high school? Thelma Brown.

I used to go down on Ramport Street and when I would go on the other side of the river I would go over to Coleman's place over on the West Bank of the river and I would also go to Copper's down the West Bank of the river and I also used to hang out. And I also used to hang out, they had a place up in Harvey called Lewis. Lewis was a bad Lemento, was an Italian type of guy. He had a nice club up there in Marrero. And he had black bartenders, white bartenders working for him back in the 40s and 50s. And we used to…

That was my next question. You probably sort of accelerated. Is that when you got out of high school, what were you going to do in life? Did you know, did you think about actually what am I going to do now?
